scope: Static source contract investigation only; proposed runtime qualification targets retained Windows2007 executable bytes only.
comparison_method: Read-only local git show <full commit>:<path>; SHA-256 over exact blob bytes; no branch/ref/worktree change.

inspection_scope: docs/evidence paths containing native-fx, integrated-alternatives and Windows combined MSI2006/2007
existing_evidence.conclusion: Existing standalone MSVC DSP+codec evidence and factory/model source checks do not qualify full application rendering, MSCZ save/reopen or human listening. No duplicate application qualification was found.

references.fact: Explicitly excludes Qt, complete factory/mixer, complete application, MSCZ save, application render and listening.
AU12 remains partial: complete projects with native effects, reopen/export and listening await qualification.
Actual IFxProcessor/MuseFxResolver tests, with no application or GUI instantiated.

contract_references.fact: Exact IDs Cadence EQ, Cadence Compressor and cadence.fx.schema key.
Six exact parameter names, defaults and valid ranges for each effect.
Decode requires supported ID, schema string1, at most7 map entries, known parameter names and finite in-range decimal text.
Encode emits schema1 and six numeric parameter string entries.
CADENCE_BUILD factory creates native adapter only for exact native IDs and MuseFx type.
Metadata: MusePlugin type, vendor Cadence, native editor support true, category EQ or Dynamics.
Metadata category attribute key is categories.
MusePlugin JSON resource type string is muse_plugin.
MusePlugin maps to AudioFxType MuseFx.
Reads master, aux and tracks with partId/instrumentId and in/out objects from actual MscReader audio.settings JSON.
Writes actual MscWriter audio.settings JSON: master, aux, tracks and activeSoundProfile.
Output JSON uses fxChain object, balance float, volumeDb float and auxSends array.
fxChain keys parse to chain-order integers; each FX reads active, chainOrder, resourceMeta and unitConfiguration.
Each auxSends object reads signalAmount float and active bool.
unitConfiguration stores each decoded string as base64 in JSON; raw decimal strings in JSON would be wrong.
fxChain writer emits object keys from actual chain slot numbers.
FX writer preserves active, chainOrder, resourceMeta and unitConfiguration.
unitConfiguration writer base64-encodes each byte string.
AUX_CHANNEL_NUM is2.
An empty auxSends array inserts default aux sends; explicit two inactive zero sends are required for dry trials.
Opening saved settings prepares and applies DSP then resets history, so saved output/makeup gain starts immediately.
Adapter returns unchanged samples for inactive/invalid/unsupported state and runs native EQ or comp otherwise.
Track chain effects process before track volume/balance.
Aux returns process before master native FX; master FX precede master volume/balance.
Master completion applies only master volume/balance, so sufficiently quiet fixed gain trials have an analytic amplitude relation.

proposed_serialization.active: Boolean, false for bypass and true for active case
proposed_serialization.unitConfiguration_encoding: Base64 per entry; decoded cadence.fx.schema is the string1 and each parameter is numeric decimal text.
proposed_serialization.master_and_aux_chains: Keep explicit empty fxChain for baseline, dry aux outputs; FX only on the designated target bus.

proposed_oracles.name: baseline_bypass
proposed_oracles.assertion: At identical fixed volume and explicitly dry two sends, bypass samples match baseline within declared PCM quantization/numerical tolerance; preserve and compare decoded configuration and metadata after actual project.save and reopening in a fresh application process.

reference.fact: Inactive adapter does not process samples.

proposed_oracles.name: eq_known_gain
proposed_oracles.assertion: Active musical render amplitude ratio approximates10^(-6/20), with peak and RMS ratios plus scaled residual checked against declared PCM tolerance. This establishes processing and state restoration; it is not a listening-quality oracle.

references.fact: EQ output gain is10^(gainDb/20), reset from saved target then applied per sample.

proposed_oracles.name: compressor_known_makeup_gain
proposed_oracles.assertion: At fixed safe level active musical render amplitude ratio approximates10^(6/20), with scaled residual and peak/RMS ratios checked. Ratio1 makes target reduction zero; this verifies real compressor processing path, not dynamic gain reduction.

references.fact: Saved makeup starts immediately and ratio1 makes reduction slope zero.
Existing factory test checks the same saved makeup gain on first frame.

proposed_oracles.name: optional_actual_dynamic_compression
proposed_oracles.assertion: For demonstrably above-threshold musical input, active RMS is measurably below bypass while finite/nonzero and unsaturated; makeup0 and nonnegative reduction mean compressor gain does not exceed unity. Specify threshold evidence before interpreting unchanged RMS as a failure. No exact steady-state curve or subjective quality is inferred from musical material.

references.fact: Peak detector, nonnegative reduction and time-dependent gain application.

proposed_oracles.name: all_audio
proposed_oracles.assertion: Decode and inspect actual PCM for every render: finite values, positive frame count, declared sample rate/channel count, nonzero RMS, peaks below saturation and consistent timeline; compare reopened render to direct render under predeclared tolerance.

limits: Static source byte equivalence does not transfer Windows2007 runtime qualification to candidate2008.
No GUI mixer interaction, audio-device behavior, perceptual quality, installer operation or external plugin coverage is established by this investigation.
Any fixed gain comparison must use identical sound selection, rendering format, volume/balance and explicit dry sends, plus enough headroom to avoid output saturation.
Use fresh isolated application profiles and process-job cleanup; no mutation of original stage or corresponding sources.

application_save_reopen_path.scope: Static exact-source proof that separate CLI processes call the actual project load/save and project audio-settings reader/writer; native execution remains pending
application_save_reopen_path.conclusion: CLI output MSCZ routes to notationProject->save(out), not a harness ZIP copy. Native input reload uses notationProject->load(in,openParams) and ProjectAudioSettings::read; project writing calls m_projectAudioSettings->write.
